headline: Debt bondage alleged at Tamil Nadu spinning mill
content: Article based on interviews with 14 current and former workers alleges migrant workers are recruited through agents who advance fees then deduct repayments from wages; the mill declined to comment and the NGO report it cites is unpublished.

headline: NGO investigation finds recruitment-fee debt bondage in Tiruppur-area spinning mills
content: NGO field investigation found workers repaying recruitment advances through wage deductions and identity documents held by recruiters; findings consistent with the press article and with ILO indicators of forced labour.

headline: ILO notes bonded labour risk in Tamil Nadu spinning mills
content: Sector-level report documenting recruitment debt in Tamil Nadu spinning mills; does not name this mill.

headline: Workers describe forced overtime at Indian garment factory
content: Named workers say refusal to work overtime leads to lost bonuses and threats of dismissal; the factory supplies UK retailers.

headline: Union claims unpaid wages at garment factory
content: Union bulletin claims two weeks of wages were withheld; no response from management and no independent verification.

headline: Social media post alleges child workers at factory
content: Anonymous post with no evidence or named source alleging child workers; not corroborated by audits.

headline: Retailers' cotton traced to Xinjiang ginneries
content: Investigation traced cotton in several apparel supply chains to Aksu ginneries in Xinjiang; Brown Textiles named among suppliers.

headline: Xinjiang polysilicon link to electricals makers
content: Report links Xinjiang polysilicon producers to consumer electricals supply chains; Arnold Industries listed as a buyer.

headline: Debt bondage claims at Vietnamese garment factory
content: Association report on recruitment fees at FAC-0003, supplier Harris Manufacturing.

headline: Dongguan packaging maker fined over wastewater discharge
content: Local regulator fined Sunrise Pack Co. Ltd for exceeding wastewater discharge limits at its print plant; the company said it has fixed the treatment plant.

headline: Forum post alleges unpaid overtime at Sunrise Pack
content: Anonymous post claims workers were not paid overtime; no named source and no corroboration.

headline: BVI shell companies used to hide Chinese manufacturers' owners
content: Reporting on BVI holding companies with nominee directors used by Guangdong manufacturers; Pearl River Holdings is named in the dataset but without allegations.

headline: Savage Products reported to be missing payments to lenders
content: Trade finance press reports Savage Products has delayed repayments to two lenders and is seeking to renegotiate its credit facilities; the company has not commented.

headline: Smith Products cuts shifts as merino orders fall
content: Industry weekly reports Smith Products has cut shifts at its knitting plant and delayed supplier payments after a fall in orders; management says it expects recovery.
